capabilities: Apply one of six preset article layouts
Preview the article at phone and iPad widths
Copy styled HTML with embedded images to the clipboard
Export a standalone HTML file with images
Save a default preset and a Markdown sign-off
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian theme or workspace layout; it restyles note content for pasting into the WeChat Official Account editor.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later. Embedded notes, blocks, PDFs, audio, video and Canvas files must be converted to text or images before publishing; remote images are fetched from their original hosts.
problem: Markdown notes pasted into the WeChat editor lose their headings, spacing and images, so each article has to be restyled by hand.
summary: Formatter that applies one of six WeChat Official Account layouts to a note and copies the styled text with its images for pasting into the WeChat editor.
